about_the_game:
Straight from the 90s, 90FX recreates the feel and experience of once revolutionary racing games of the early 90s.

True to its retro origin, the game has a direct and precise steering, fast racing, combined with improvements and additions from newer games.

With 40 vehicles racing each other, optionally armed with weapons, there always is something going on. Even when you are leading you will encounter mines and leftovers of those behind you.

From chaotic first laps to massive shootouts, and sometimes chill cruising, the game has something for everyone.

A rather competent and adaptive AI (still to be tweaked during Early Access) will not hesitate to leave you in the dust if you crash, or shoot you in the back when you dont expect it.

No rubberbanding AI, so that every crash, every blown up opponent has an impact on how the race will evolve, while rewarding your racing skills.

Built with keyboard as baseline for controls. Every track, every turn, every shortcut is built and designed to be played with keyboard and gamepad treated as equal input devices, so that you can use the one you prefer.

Just as basic controls, the weapons too are created with simple and reactive controls in mind, so that exploding your opponents vehicles is intuitive and engaging, not a fight against the games controls.

Visually simple and abstract, yet colorful and shiny at the same time, while staying true to its roots in the 90s.

Designed to always keep you ahead of what happens in the game by using easily to understand and distinctive colors for everything important while racing, without sacrificing performance.


So, what are you waiting for?

Come and experience, or relive, the 90s... not what it actually looked like, but what it felt like.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: AMD Phenom / Intel Pentium
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 470 / nvidia GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The game will not run on Windows 7 and/or DirectX 11.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 / Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
